findings.text: follow-on: the exclusive-open predicate for the move-aside exemption (an os.open guarded by O_EXCL, inside a try that catches FileExistsError) is written a second time here, where the identical comprehension already sits in the not_created loop at :382; the diff extracted catches_file_exists for the handler test but not this open predicate, so a change to what counts as an exclusive create must be made in two places in one function.

follow-on: the new case exercises only the rename-in-a-helper branch; the plan's other named branch — an inline rename of a path a helper created, handled at reckon/interface_counts.py:362 by local - callers_not_staging[name] — has no case, so a regression of that half of the exemption would pass the whole gate.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit from adea717b3 to 9481c9371; f9ea0650 changes reckon/interface_counts.py (extracts resolve_callee, catches_file_exists and bind_arguments, adds exclusive_creators and callers_not_staging, subtracts the exempted locals) and tests/test_staged_write_inventory.py (one new case, +32 lines), and 9481c9371 adds the 30-line evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_staged_write_inventory.py's test_every_staged_write_reaches_the_owner (expected set unchanged), a new three-function case, and a logged negative control; the worker ran all seven interface_counts importers and recorded head 119 passed EXIT=0, base 117 passed 1 failed EXIT=1, and the control 2 failed 48 passed EXIT=1.
item_verdicts.goal: read the source node goal ("Make the census detector exempt a claim move-aside whose exclusive create or rename sits one helper away") and the landed code at reckon/interface_counts.py:259-334; the detector now resolves each call's callee, recognises a helper that exclusively creates one of its own parameters, and excludes the argument a caller hands such a helper, so a later rename of that path — inline or through a helper — is not reported, while a renamed parameter from a non-exclusive helper is still reported.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, commits f9ea0650 and 9481c9371, the head/base/control logs, the measurement module and cwd for the scratch base arm, and the five-entry inventory figure.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared write paths are reckon/interface_counts.py, tests/test_staged_write_inventory.py, the plan fragment, and the figures dir; the two commits touch exactly those first three, and no path outside the fence is modified.

justifications.durability: the new case pins the delegated move-aside against a literal expected set and the recorded control reddens it (EXIT=1, 2 failed) when the exemption is removed, but the branch at reckon/interface_counts.py:362 is exercised by no case.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_staged_write_inventory.py::test_every_staged_write_reaches_the_owner and the new case re-run green in the reviewed worktree at 9481c9371 (EXIT=0), and added_failure_count 0 is a measured zero — the base log yields the one failure id and the head none, computed with reckon/crew/review.py:2100.
justifications.fit: the new helpers follow the module's existing nested-helper idiom (reckon/interface_counts.py:232 source_name, :245 rename_source) and the test is mechanism-named; the branches, comments and fragment carry no plan label, ticket id or author attribution.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/interface_counts.py:362 exempts a local a helper exclusively created and :400-402 exempts the forwarded parameter, so the delegated claim move-aside is unreported while reckon/crew/routing.py::_release_worktree_whole stays reported (re-run inventory still lists all five entries, EXIT=0).
justifications.reuse: no other owner of AST callee-resolution or argument-binding exists (grep for posonlyargs/kwonlyargs over reckon/ returns only reckon/interface_counts.py), so the helpers extend their own module rather than forking one; the only duplication is the exclusive-open predicate repeated within the function.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff adea717b3..9481c9371 touches only reckon/interface_counts.py, tests/test_staged_write_inventory.py and the node's own fragment, every one inside the declared write paths.
